thread:
maria: Quick convo — tradeoffs for delegated cancellation + fallback coordination at the edge. Thinking about adding a small surface so frontdoor can tell downstream how to treat client cancels (passthrough vs drain) and whether fallbacks should be attempted. Thoughts? :thinking:
ryan: +1 we need something explicit. Currently cancel is blackhole — upstream gets EOF suddenly and we rely on idempotency keys for safety. messy for streaming requests.
theo: Agree. Two modes I keep coming back to: `passthrough` (immediate cancel, no retry) and `graceful` (signal downstream to finish current token window/commit then close). `graceful` lets us avoid duplicate side effects but increases tail latency.
jess: Observability question — how do we surface whether a fallback triggered because of a client cancel vs an upstream error? Need new spans/metrics. Otherwise SRE can’t tell if retries are causing duplicate billing.
maria: Good point. Proposal: add header `x-rw-cancel-mode: passthrough|graceful|ack` plus `x-rw-retry-hint: safe|unsafe|ask` . Upstream can return `x-rw-can-retry: yes|no|maybe` on initial handshake. That lets the gateway decide hedging vs fallback.
ryan: I like `x-rw-retry-hint`. Implementation detail: for streaming we’d need an early handshake (100-continue-style) so upstream communicates safe-to-retry before token emission. Otherwise we already streamed side effects.
theo: Implementation-wise, we can piggyback on our existing preflight route check: when route is assigned, do a cheap OPTIONS-like preflight that returns these headers. Low QPS and cached per-instance.
jess: Ops: add metrics `edge.cancel.mode.<mode>.count`, `edge.cancel.fallback.triggered` and tag `initiator:client|edge|upstream`. Also emit a trace event when we convert a client cancel into a fallback attempt.
maria: What about idempotency enforcement? If `x-rw-retry-hint=unsafe` we must not automatically retry/fallback. Maybe offer a configurable policy per-route: `fallback_on_cancel: always|never|conditional` where conditional consults `x-rw-can-retry`.
ryan: For long-running streaming calls (SDK websockets or gRPC) we should support an `ack` mode where edge sends an ACK to client that it received cancel and will finish current commit and then respond with final status — prevents client from assuming retry happened. Could be `x-rw-cancel-mode: ack`.
theo: Edge complexity: maintaining outstanding commit timers for thousands of streams. We should limit `graceful`/`ack` to requests with a `x-rw-commit-window-ms` header (or default 100ms) to avoid unbounded resource hold.
maria: UX: default should be `passthrough` for normal API routes, `graceful` or `ack` opt-in for write-heavy endpoints. Docs + SDKs must document semantic: cancel does not guarantee server aborted work.
jess: Failure modes: if graceful timer expires and upstream stalls, edge should force-cancel and surface `cancel_forced=true` in logs and to client. Also track `fallback_count` so we can bill/alert.
ryan: Security/abuse: attacker could set commit-window very large to hold resources. We need route-level max windows and a tenant quota. Also ensure `x-rw-` headers are only honored if authenticated + route-enabled.
Theo: Minor protocol sketch (example):
```
Client -> Edge: POST /chat
Edge -> Upstream preflight: GET /_rw_preflight -> returns headers:
  x-rw-retry-hint: safe
  x-rw-can-retry: yes
  x-rw-max-commit-window-ms: 200
Client cancels -> Edge honors policy: if mode=graceful -> send `x-rw-signal: cancel-graceful` to upstream and start timer
Upstream finalizes and returns 200 or 409
Edge forwards result to client or initiates fallback
```
maria: Nice. Next: who owns SIG changes? @ryan can you prototype preflight + headers? @theo please add admission limits for commit windows. @jess can you draft metrics/tracing specs?
ryan: Yep — I'll spike this week. Will push proto to `edge/protocol/preflight` and tag.
theo: I'll add config knobs to route schema: `cancel_mode_default`, `max_commit_window_ms`, and `fallback_policy`.
jess: I'll write a short SLO/alert doc: `fallback_rate > 0.5%` and `forced_cancel_rate` tracked per-org.
maria: Thanks all. If we get rough proto in a PR I’ll run it by privacy/compliance for any semantics we need to disclose. :thumbsup:
